**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, "connection-per-request for pool isolation"), deployed 2026-03-14 02:12–02:14 UTC. Right after it landed, the pool started leaking connections — `in_use` pinned at 20/20 and the waiting queue climbed without ever recovering, from 13 waiters to 70+ by the end of the log. Every failure is `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

**Impact window:** started 02:14:14 UTC (first slow-acquire warning), first 503 at 02:14:18 UTC. Still failing at 03:59:27 UTC, the last line in the log — not yet resolved.

**Scope:** gateway only. `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/orders`, and `/v1/catalog/search` are all 503ing. `/health` keeps returning 200 throughout. Worker service is unaffected — its own pool and jobs stayed healthy the whole time.

**Action:** roll back `dep-4471`. No other deploy that night touches the gateway or its connection pool.
